author: GameTrailers
description:
Entropy is available now in Steam Early Access. Watch the Entropy early access launch trailer for this dark fantasy, tactical turn-based RPG from the creators of Dread Delusion. Entropy tells the tale of a land where only pockets of humanity remain. There was no pivotal apocalyptic event to speak of; only the cruel march of time and the inexplicable infertility of the world, which comes to life via the game’s conscious artistic approach to recreate PSX-level graphics from past gaming eras. 

Accursed creatures stalk the defoliated lands between settlements, which are themselves terrible places; squalid, medieval and mostly ruled by tyrants. 

Putting players in the role of party leader, it’s up to you to determine who joins your party of up to six - there are plenty willing to work, but choosing who is most fit for your battles may mean the difference between success and failure.
title: Entropy - Official Early Access Launch Trailer

description:
Get a fresh look at gameplay from King in the Mountain in this latest trailer for the upcoming calm strategic incremental mining game about rebuilding a fallen dwarven kingdom. King in the Mountain will be available on PC. A public playtest is available on Steam today, August 18, through August 25, 2026.

In King in the Mountain, you send teams of dwarves underground in search of gold, gems, and ancient artifacts. 

Choose where they should dig and watch them carve their way through the mountain, but every expedition is limited by one thing: the torch. Once the lights go out, it’s not safe and your dwarves have to go back to the base to regroup. The deeper you go, the greater the potential rewards, but every new tunnel costs precious time. Push your luck for one more treasure or turn back while there is still enough light to make it home.

title: King in the Mountain - Official Playtest Trailer
